data.name: Suransh
data.gender_notes: Suransh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Suransh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means Sun. The name Suransh is a compound of two words 'Sur' meaning Sun and 'Ansh' meaning soul. The name Suransh signifies the Sun God, the one who illuminates the soul with the light of knowledge and wisdom. The name Suransh carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Suransh usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is also said that the name Suransh helps the child to overcome challenges and achieve success in life.
